**Finding submitted: deviation (medium severity, warranty).**

**What the document says.** Section 7.3 (¶p0078) does contain an express conformance warranty for the Software and MarketSite.net Service plus a media warranty, and ¶p0079 provides a real remedy chain (correction → replacement → termination with refund of prepaid fees). Section 11.2 usefully makes post-Warranty-Period conformance a material condition, and Exhibit C support is a practical backstop. The disclaimer (¶p0084) reaches implied warranties only and does not swallow the express warranties.

**Why it deviates.** The duration falls below even our fallback: sixty (60) days measured from the **Effective Date** rather than delivery or acceptance, hard-capped at **December 31, 1999** — so the warranty can lapse before or immediately after deployment. The malicious-code warranty is tied to that same short window and narrowed to "willfully introduced" code. There is also no professional-and-workmanlike warranty for the installation, implementation, support, training and professional services promised in Section 5.

**Redline (validated ok:true).**
1. ¶p0078 — 60 days from Effective Date / December 31, 1999 sunset → **twelve (12) months from the date of delivery**.
2. ¶p0078 — malicious-code warranty made continuous through the term and no longer limited to "willfully introduced" code.
3. New §7.5 after ¶p0082 — services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, with re-performance or refund of fees for non-conforming services.

The remedy in 7.3 was left intact as already adequate, and the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services) is offered in the comment.
